candidates.hook: The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's attack and knocks him out with a devastating punch to the floor.
candidates.cliffhanger: The Bearded Stranger drops to one knee on the cathedral aisle and presents a silver band, asking 'Lady Juliana... accept my hand.'
candidates.why: Starts with instant action, delivers high-stakes hero dialogue, and ends on a stunning public proposal cliffhanger.

candidates.hook: Lady in Gold Gown sneers at Juliana, 'Look at you... still clinging to that little locket as if it can make you worthy of a place here.'
candidates.cliffhanger: The Noble Matriarch disowns Juliana completely ('Your father has chosen his family... and it isn't you') and shouts 'Guards! Remove her!'
candidates.why: Establishes maximum sympathy for Juliana through cruel family betrayal and ends just as physical violence begins.

candidates.hook: Noble Matriarch orders 'Guards! Remove her!' as guards forcefully grab Juliana and drag her while she screams 'Let me go!'
candidates.cliffhanger: The Bearded Stranger knocks out the lead guard and menacingly warns the remaining guard, 'Good. Then don't touch her again.'
candidates.why: Delivers high physical tension and a satisfying alpha hero rescue moment.

moments.desc: Juliana is mocked by her sister who took her wedding and groom.
Matriarch orders guards to drag Juliana away as she screams for help.
Bearded Stranger steps into the aisle and drops a guard with a single punch.
Stranger pulls out a silver ring and kneels before Juliana, proposing marriage.
